basic_info.description: This fabulous 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit boasts an inviting open floor plan, perfect for both relaxation and entertaining. Freshly painted and featuring beautifully resurfaced hardwood floors, the space exudes warmth and style. The newly installed backsplash in the kitchen adds a contemporary touch, while the high ceilings create an airy atmosphere. Equipped with stainless steel appliances and an in-unit washer/dryer, this condo offers modern convenience in a charming setting. Located in the heart of Nob Hill, you'll enjoy easy access to the financial district and Union Square, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a blend of historic elegance and modern living. Don't miss the opportunity to make this stunning condo your new home!
